invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieMergeHandle instance created by the factory, so the result should not be null unless creation fails (which would throw an exception).
partitionPath is used as an argument in the handle creation; it is likely assumed non-null as per expected API usage.
fileId is required to create the HoodieMergeHandle and is not checked for null before being used.
recordItr is passed to the HoodieMergeHandleFactory; a null iterator would likely result in an immediate failure.
Partition paths are typically non-empty strings identifying the target partition.
